Ski season and winter holidays. The lakes quiet.

maneder.en: Spring in the valley (16 °C), still skiing up high.

maneder.no: Mildt (19 °C) ved sjøene, blomstring. Heiser stengt i fjellet.
maneder.en: Mild (19 °C) by the lakes, blossom. Lifts closed in the mountains.

maneder.no: Varmt (24 °C), sjøene på sitt beste. Fjellet er fortsatt snødekt.
maneder.en: Warm (24 °C), the lakes at their best. The mountains still snowy.

maneder.en: Huts and lifts open mid-June. Flower meadows.

maneder.en: 30 °C in the valley, 15–20 °C in the mountains. Afternoon thunderstorms. High season.

maneder.en: Thunderstorms. Ferragosto: full in the mountains and by the lakes (see events).

maneder.en: Stable and clear, ideal for hiking. Grape harvest in South Tyrol.
Autumn colours (18 °C); huts and lifts close.

maneder.no: Grått og vått. Mellomsesong, mye stengt.
maneder.en: Grey and wet. Off-season, much closed.

maneder.en: Cold, snow. Christmas markets (see events); ski season begins.

vinduer.en: Christmas markets in Bolzano and Merano (late November to 6 Jan)

vinduer.en: Ferragosto 15 Aug: Italian holiday peak, full and expensive
